content.caption:
Bikepacking power planning: bigger battery isn't always the answer.

Most trips run fine on a few simple habits:
- Cut the drain: dim the screen, use airplane mode, download maps offline.
- Charge at your stops: lunch, cafés, lodging. Lights first, phone second.
- Top up a little often, instead of waiting for 5%.

Once you know how many riding days you have, you know roughly how many charging stops you need.
